# Membership Requirements Review Checklist: Add Project Members

**Purpose**: Peer-review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of authorization, membership integrity, Notification, activity, and dependency requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-08-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are authorization requirements documented at both the membership-management page boundary and the independently callable mutation boundary, including protection from private Project disclosure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-016, Contract: Pages §Access, Contract: Server Action §Authorization and validation order]
- [x] CHK002 Are selected-user eligibility requirements complete for active Members, active Admins, suspended users, nonexistent users, and users already assigned to the Project? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-003, Spec §FR-014–FR-017, Data Model §Prerequisite Entities]
- [x] CHK003 Are all required success side effects explicitly documented as one Project Membership, one unread Notification, and one Project activity entry before success is reported? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-012, Contract: Server Action §Success semantics]
- [x] CHK004 Are expected outcomes documented for missing or malformed identifiers, expired sessions, unauthorized actors, unknown Projects, unknown users, inactive users, duplicates, concurrent conflicts, and unexpected failures? [Completeness, Contract: Server Action §Expected errors and side effects]
- [x] CHK005 Are active-Project and archived-Project membership outcomes both fully specified, including immediate discoverability and the applicable access level? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-007, Contract: Pages §`/projects/[projectKey]`]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “immediately” defined by an objective point—committed membership before Admin success and availability on the recipient's next request—across the specification and contracts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005–FR-006, Spec §SC-003, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK007 Is “Notification delivery” clearly distinguished from durable Notification creation, next-request visibility, and live updates to an already-open page? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008–FR-011, Research §Decision 5, Contract: Events §Consumer freshness]
- [x] CHK008 Are “normal conditions” and “normal operating conditions” defined precisely enough to make the 30-second and 5-second targets reproducible? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK009 Is “suspended, inactive, or otherwise inactive” reduced to an explicit account-state set that implementers and reviewers can apply consistently? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §`users`]
- [x] CHK010 Is “normal member access” defined through an unambiguous authoritative dependency rather than left open to interpretation within this feature? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Foundation Dependency Gate, Contract: Pages §`/projects/[projectKey]`]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Are the delayed-Notification requirements consistent with the design requirement that membership, Notification, and activity records commit or roll back together? [Conflict, Spec §FR-010–FR-011, Data Model §Add-Member Transaction, Contract: Events §Atomicity contract]
- [x] CHK012 Is an Admin's ability to manage a Project without being a Project member consistent across this feature and the prerequisite Project access requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Contract: Pages §Access, Plan §Foundation Dependency Gate]
- [x] CHK013 Are exactly-once requirements consistent with the documented historical-membership rule that a later re-add creates a new membership period and new side effects? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013–FR-014, Data Model §State Transitions, Contract: Events §Atomicity contract]
- [x] CHK014 Are candidate-control requirements consistent about whether already assigned and inactive users are omitted, shown as disabled, or otherwise distinguished? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-017, Contract: Pages §Server-rendered content]
- [x] CHK015 Is the Notification-link requirement consistent with resolving the destination from the Project's current key after a Project rename? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §`notifications`, Contract: Events §Membership-added Notification]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Does the 95% first-attempt usability criterion define a sample size, participant profile, and what counts as an attempt without guidance? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK017 Does the 30-second completion criterion define its start point, end point, and treatment of network or server delays? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK018 Does the 99%-within-5-seconds Notification criterion define the observation point, sample size, and whether a fresh server read is required? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK019 Do the 100% integrity criteria define representative unauthorized, ineligible, duplicate, repeated, and synchronized-concurrency datasets? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006–SC-007, Quickstart §Scenarios 3–5]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are primary requirements complete for adding an eligible user, gaining Project access, receiving an unread Notification, and recording Project activity? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–2, Spec §FR-004–FR-012]
- [x] CHK021 Are exception requirements complete for authentication, authorization, malformed input, missing entities, ineligibility, and duplicate membership without leaking private state? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §User Story 3, Contract: Server Action §Expected errors and side effects]
- [x] CHK022 Is the concurrency scenario explicit about the winning and losing outcomes as well as the required final cardinality of all three records? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3 Scenario 3, Spec §FR-013, Contract: Server Action §Concurrency and idempotency]
- [x] CHK023 Are recovery requirements complete for transaction failure, temporary recipient-view staleness, and a safe Admin retry without a false membership-failure message? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-010–FR-011, Data Model §Add-Member Transaction, Contract: Pages §Form states]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Is the “Admin loses administrative privileges” edge case reconciled with the prerequisite account model's restrictions on changing Admin accounts and with session expiry/revocation behavior? [Conflict, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Foundation Dependency Gate]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a selected user's account state changing between page generation, submission, and transaction completion? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §User Story 3 Scenario 4, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the Project changing between active and archived status while the add action is in progress? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, Data Model §State Transitions]
- [x] CHK027 Are self-add by an Admin, adding another Admin, and the no-eligible-users state explicitly permitted or excluded? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §`users`, Contract: Pages §Form states]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK028 Are privacy and data-minimization requirements complete for candidate lists, expected errors, logs, Notification contents, and Project discovery? [Security, Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §Retention and Privacy, Contract: Server Action §Security properties]
- [x] CHK029 Are accessibility requirements for labeling, disabled-state reasons, keyboard order, focus, status announcements, zoom, and narrow widths clearly normative for this feature? [Accessibility, Completeness, Contract: Pages §Accessibility]
- [x] CHK030 Are scale assumptions and performance targets consistent with the stated fewer-than-20-user scope and the choice not to require search, bulk selection, polling, or push updates? [Consistency, Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context, Research §Decisions 5 and 8]
- [x] CHK031 Are freshness requirements complete for Admin confirmation, recipient Project discovery, Notification visibility, and an already-open recipient page? [Coverage, Non-Functional, Spec §FR-005–FR-011, Contract: Events §Consumer freshness]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 Are the account, session, Project, activity, and Notification prerequisites assigned to authoritative feature artifacts with compatible states, identifiers, and ownership boundaries? [Dependency, Plan §Foundation Dependency Gate, Data Model §Entity Overview]
- [x] CHK033 Are delegated Notification read/unread, retention, Project privacy, archived access, and activity-feed behaviors specific enough to prevent conflicting implementations? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §Retention and Privacy]
- [x] CHK034 Is the boundary between feature-008 membership addition and out-of-scope removal, bulk changes, role customization, external notifications, and Notification deletion explicit and consistent across artifacts? [Scope, Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constraints, Data Model §State Transitions]

## Notes

- Focus: balanced authorization/concurrency integrity and Notification/activity integration review.
- Depth and timing: standard peer review before task generation.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add review findings inline beneath the relevant item.
